about: Intercepting routes: the URL pattern a file in a slot takes over. `owner` is the path to the @slot directory, `inner` the file's stem inside it (route groups still in); `target` null = no target. Run by crates/nowaki-core/tests/intercepts.rs (routes::intercept_target) and scripts/router-test.mjs (router.mjs interceptTarget).

cases.name: (..) climbs one URL segment; groups don't count
(...) is the root; index is the directory
a marker deeper in the slot counts from its own directory
a bare marker directory has no target
groups after the marker are left out
a suffixed param keeps its suffix
